full_judgment: 2. On 20.11.81 the complainant petitioner Md. Islam filed a complaint before the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Coz's Bazar alleging that his master M.S. Hasan had auction purchased 14.10 acres of land in the plots described in the schedule on 13.11.81 in Receiver Misc. Case No. 12 of 1973-74. under section 145 Cr.P.C. Accused Abdul Karim prayed for time to stop the auction sale but C.O. (Revenue) rejected the prayer. Thereafter on 16.11.81 and 17.11.81 accused respondents Abdul Karim, Abdur Rahman, Abdul Chabi, Abdul Gafur, Siddique Ahmed, Yusuf Ali, Nurul Hoque, Nurul Huda, Abu, Pattan, Lal Mia cut and took away the ripe Aman paddy worth Tk. 12,000/- from 4.47 acres of the said land. The learned Magistrate examined the complainant and asked O.C, Ramu P.S. for enquiry and report. After receipt of the repot the 11 accused persons were summoned under section 379 of the Penal Code on 12.1.82. Out of 11 accused persons 8 accused persons surrendered and were released on bail. On dates previous to 25.3.82 complainant remained present. On 25.3.82 complainant was absent by petition and the learned Magistrate on that date did not acquit the accused under section 247 Cr.P.C. but adjourned the case to 19.1.88 thereafter complainant remained present on various successive fixed dates. But on 14 11.82 complainant's Lawyer filed a petition stating that the case should be adjourned as the complainant had not appeared on that date.
